label: Nominal ten-vitamin preparation described by JCM197, NBRC837 and NBRC903

source_inputs.scope: Nominal Biotin agrees. These recipe labels do not independently settle a commercial source, hydration state or all stereochemical specificity; no extra molecular specificity is assigned here.
Nominal Folic acid agrees; no extra salt or hydration state is inferred.
Hydrochloride salt is explicit in all four recipes and the current product. Hydration and lot identity are not specified; no free-base substitution.
Hydrochloride is explicit in all four recipes. The current product says only Thiamine: that omission proves neither a free base nor equivalence to the hydrochloride. No inferred monohydrate.
Nominal Riboflavin agrees; no unprinted stereochemical, salt or hydrate qualification is introduced.
Nicotinic acid is explicit; do not substitute nicotinamide or a generic vitamin-B3 identity.

ATCC2672 explicitly specifies D-(+); JCM197, NBRC837, NBRC903 and current MD-VS do not. Missing D does not prove equality, difference, racemate, or biological default. ATCC is a more qualified recipe statement, not an exact source bridge for the others.
Vitamin B12 remains the printed family-level label; no cyanocobalamin or other vitamer is inferred merely from customary use.
The para locant and acid name are explicit. No aminobenzoate salt, other positional isomer or titrant is inferred.

Lipoic acid and thioctic acid are the nominal synonymous acid names used in the compared tables. None prints an R/S qualifier; preserve the maintained historical correction away from an R-specific component and do not restore a stereoisomer by default.

All four recipes list 1 L distilled water as an input. They do not say make up to a final volume of 1 L. Exact final-volume concentrations, water volume fraction, density and solute displacement are not established. Current MD-VS states mg/liter formulation and 10 mL product volume but does not enumerate the water input.

quantification: Source batch masses with numeric spelling normalized in source_values, plus 1 L listed water input. Exact source spellings remain in the hashed captures and primary matrix. Final solution volume, exact concentration denominator and purchase/lot identity are not established. No inferred density/displacement or normalized MG_PER_L/L_PER_L.

JCM197.stock: Filter sterilize trace vitamins while gassing with N2.
JCM197.addition: Aseptically and anaerobically add trace vitamins under N2-CO2 (80:20).
JCM197.parent: Parent medium autoclaved under N2-CO2 (80:20); final parent pH 6.8.
JCM197.exclusions: NaHCO3 8%, separate sulfide/cysteine 5% solutions, mineral-stock pH 7/KOH and parent pH are not vitamin-stock composition/pH. No quantified nitrogen component is established.

NBRC837.stock: Vitamin solution is filter-sterile; no explicit vitamin-stock N2-gassing direction.
NBRC837.addition: Aseptically and anaerobically add the filter-sterile vitamin solution.
NBRC837.parent: Parent autoclaved under N2/CO2 (80/20); final parent pH 6.8.
NBRC837.exclusions: Do not transfer JCM197 stock gassing to NBRC837. Separate sulfide/cysteine 5% stock instructions and mineral pH 7/KOH are not vitamin-stock instructions.

NBRC903.addition: Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add vitamin, sulfur and sulfide.
NBRC903.parent: Parent pH 7 and autoclaving under N2.
NBRC903.exclusions: No explicit vitamin-stock gas instruction. Three-day 105 C sulfur treatment and neutralized 5% sulfide stock are separate components. Mineral-stock pH 6.5/7 and KOH do not define vitamin-stock pH.

known_positive_boundary: MD-VSproduct/source definition has added phosphate/catalogue provenance; omission ofD isnotadifferenceproof. NCMAhasgenuine11-solutephosphate-containingformulaandperliterbasis.
remaining_owner_decision: The authentic CultureBotHT source lineage supports a bounded correction on its existing generic owner path. Whether a common nominal owner scope should include JCM197/NBRC837/NBRC903 remains a curator identity-model decision: their generic B12, listed batch masses plus water input and source-specific preparation do not establish exact equality with the CultureBotHT cyanocobalamin mg/L table/X100 definition, and do not prove difference. Do not mint a source-number identity or release exact aliases by label.
